claims.head: Forecheck against patience
claims.body: On forecheck pressure, Carolina is one of the league’s best, but Chicago is one of the worst. They’re about as far apart as two teams get. Expect the Hurricanes to win more pucks back deep in the Blackhawks’ end.

CHI.head: The Hurricanes should be favored
CHI.body: Even though Chicago has home-ice advantage, Carolina has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. To pull this off, the Blackhawks can start with getting good looks, plus a goalie who steals the show.

CAR.head: A big edge for the Hurricanes
CAR.body: Even though Chicago has home-ice advantage, Carolina has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. The Blackhawks’ best way in is getting good looks.
